problem:
Consider the vectors ${v}_{1}$ and ${v}_{3}$ and the block diagonal matrix $B$ shown below, where both $2\times 2$ blocks of $B$ represent rotation-scaling matrices:

$$
{v}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}-3+4\text{i} \\ 3+7\text{i} \\ 5 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,{v}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 3+2\text{i} \\ 1+\text{i} \\ 3\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 2 & 0 & 0 \\ -2 & -1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 3 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$

The vectors ${v}_{1}$ and ${v}_{3}$ are the eigenvectors of a matrix $A$ corresponding to the eigenvalues ${\lambda }_{1}=-1+2\text{i}$ and ${\lambda }_{3}=3-2\text{i},$ respectively. 
Given that $A=PB{P}^{-1},$ which of the following could be the matrix $P?$
